errors.text_span: Die vertikale Achse listet die Branchen in alphabetischer Reihenfolge von oben nach unten auf
errors.evidence: The categories are not in alphabetical order; they are sorted by bar length (descending).
The figure shows the „Nahrungs- und Genussmittel“ bar at approximately 48%, not 46%.
The figure shows the „Einzelhandel“ bar at approximately 44%, not 40%.
The figure shows the „Baugewerbe“ bar at approximately 8%, not 11%.
The figure shows the „Bergbau“ bar at approximately 12%, not 10%.
The figure shows the „Größere Betriebe (250+)“ bar at approximately 39%, not 37%.
The figure shows the „Kleinbetriebe (10-49)“ bar at approximately 35%, not 32%.
The figure shows the „Kleinstbetriebe (1-9)“ bar at approximately 19%, not 25%.
The description incorrectly states the chart purpose as showing the impact of minimum wage increases, which is not supported by the figure or atoms.

errors.text_span: der nach Branche und Betriebsgröße von der Mindestlohnanhebung auf 12 Euro betroffen ist
errors.evidence: The description introduces an unsupported claim about minimum wage impact, which is not present in the figure or atoms.
The description does not mention the small gap in the vertical axis between the industry categories and the business size categories.

errors.evidence: The business size categories are sorted in ascending order (250+ to 1-9), not descending.
